transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this pre-shutdown huddle going. As we all know, C-1 is down after its failure and C-2 is our available backup air source. The next customer campaign is scheduled for the weekend and it depends on the compressed-air system. I need to hear from facilities, production scheduling, environmental health and safety, and quality — please state any open constraints you have before I finalize and record the maintenance and operating plan for the weekend work order. Let's hear them one at a time.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have an open constraint from facilities. My failure assessment on C-1 identified a burned motor winding. The good news is we have a replacement motor already in plant stores, and I confirmed this morning that the maintenance estimate to change it out is exactly 10 hours. I haven't entered this into the CMMS work order yet, but the parts and labor estimate are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have an open constraint from production scheduling. My customer schedule requires the campaign to begin at exactly Saturday 06:00 with full air pressure. If the compressor repair is not complete by then, the campaign must be moved to Sunday 08:00. I confirmed this in the customer scheduling portal today but haven't copied it into the plant shutdown plan yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have an open constraint from environmental health and safety. My compliance review found that C-2's receiver inspection certificate expires Friday at 18:00. The required inspection takes exactly 2 hours and must be completed before C-2 can be used over the weekend. I received the inspection status from the certified inspector today but have not updated the equipment compliance board yet.

I received the laboratory result this afternoon but have not uploaded it to the campaign quality record yet.
